description: This file contains an Android activity named AutoComplete4 demonstrating the use of AutoCompleteTextView with a custom CursorAdapter called ContactListAdapter that fetches contact names from the device's contacts database and displays suggestions based on user input.

classes.name: AutoComplete4
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating contact autocomplete feature.

classes.name: AutoComplete4.ContactListAdapter
classes.description: Custom CursorAdapter implementing Filterable for displaying contact names as suggestions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, queries contacts, and sets up the AutoCompleteTextView with a custom adapter.

methods.name: newView
methods.description: Creates a new dropdown item view for each contact.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds contact data to a dropdown view.

methods.name: convertToString
methods.description: Converts a contact cursor row to a display string.

methods.name: runQueryOnBackgroundThread
methods.description: Performs the contact name filtering query asynchronously based on user input.
